description: Recorded signal trace spanning all six SpeakPolicy decision branches. Tier B replay: each frame is replayed twice; every SpeakDecision must be bit-identical to the recorded baseline and to itself across runs.

fixture_conventions.policy_replay_safe: All fields are policy_replay_safe per the spec replay privacy policy (stable enums + numeric thresholds; no free-text PII).
fixture_conventions.baseline_decisions: Recorded expected SpeakDecision fields (action_type, primary_reason_code, supporting_reason_codes) for each signal_trace frame. Test asserts exact match — these are the Tier B baseline.
fixture_conventions.frame_coverage: 8 frames covering all 6 decision branches: (1) blocking social mode → NOT_ADDRESSED; (2) user_speaking → NOT_ADDRESSED; (3) low EOU → NOT_ADDRESSED; (4) EOU+addressed → full_response; (5) EOU+not addressed → NOT_ADDRESSED; two boundary frames near the EOU threshold; (6) EOU+high p_backchannel → backchannel (v0.1b Task 7).
fixture_conventions.p_backchannel: Optional field on signal_trace frames (default 0.0). When >= 0.7, SpeakPolicy returns action_type=backchannel with BACKCHANNEL_DETECTED. Manually injected — no BackchannelClassifier is constructed.
fixture_conventions.policy_decision: Fixture-internal expectation marker in expected_events. Not a Part 5 spec-defined adapter-emitted event_type; indicates that this fixture exercises the policy decision path and that each frame's SpeakDecision is verified against baseline_decisions.

signal_trace.notes: branch 1: blocking social mode → silence regardless of EOU/address
branch 3: EOU sub-threshold (0.45 < 0.5) → silence; near-boundary determinism check
branch 3: EOU exactly at threshold (0.50 <= 0.5) → silence; boundary determinism
branch 5: EOU confirmed but agent not addressed → silence
branch 4 again: different EOU value, still full_response; verifies determinism across varied inputs
branch 6 (v0.1b): EOU confirmed + high p_backchannel → backchannel; manually injected, no BackchannelClassifier
